full_judgment:
17. In view of the averment made in the plaint and also in the deed of sale dated 15.05.1994, it cannot be said that the disputed transfer is a sham transaction. As soon as the disputed document was registered the title of the suit land "shall be deemed to have been transferred" to the defendant. Therefore, both the Courts below wrongly came to the finding that no title in respect of the suit land was transferred to defendant. Both the Courts below also came to the finding that defendant could not prove her possession in the suit land. Admittedly, the D.P. khatian in respect of the suit land was prepared in the name of the defendant, which was admitted by the plaintiff in the plaint itself and moreover in the deed of sale the plaintiff clearly stated “নিম্ন তফছিলোক্ত বর্ণিত সম্পত্তি অদ্���ই তোমার দখলে অর্পন করিয়া দিয়া সাফ বিক্রয় ক্রমে সম্পূর্ণরুপে দখল ও সর্ব স্বত্বত্যাগী হইলাম। 

 18. In view of the statement made in the deed of sale and also the preparation of D.P. khatian in her name, it is proved that the defendant has been in possession of the suit land.
